subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official mobile setup codes grant operator.admin by default once Limited access is proven to enforce an exact bounded credential?
rationale: Changing the default pairing handoff from bounded access to administrative access is an intentional security and product boundary choice that automated tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve full default after repair
options.body: Keep full access as the recommended default, but require an exact Limited downgrade and focused fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep limited default
options.body: Preserve the shipped bounded default and expose full access only through an explicit operator-selected option.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the PR until the mobile authorization model and least-privilege experience are redesigned.

recommendation.title: Approve full default after repair
recommendation.body: Keep full access as the recommended default, but require an exact Limited downgrade and focused fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this person most directly to the feature direction and implementation, though current-main ownership remains unverified.
